questions.question: The primary function of a Cathode Ray Oscilloscope (CRO) is to:

explanations.b: The CRO’s main purpose is to display electrical signals as waveforms on a screen. It allows you to analyze voltage variations with respect to time, making it essential for studying circuit behavior.

questions.question: The horizontal axis of a CRO display usually represents:

explanations.c: The X-axis represents time because the CRO plots voltage (on the Y-axis) against time. This helps in observing how the signal changes over a given period.

questions.question: Which control on a CRO adjusts the brightness of the waveform?

explanations.b: The intensity control adjusts the brightness of the electron beam hitting the screen. Increasing it makes the trace brighter, while decreasing it dims the display.

questions.question: The “Volts/div” control on a CRO is used to:

explanations.b: The “Volts/div” knob sets how many volts each vertical division represents, letting you scale the waveform’s height accurately to measure voltage amplitude.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a waveform type that can be displayed on a CRO?

explanations.d: CROs display continuous signals like sine, square, and triangular waves. Hexagonal waves don’t exist in standard signal generation or waveform analysis.

questions.question: The trigger control on a CRO is used to:

explanations.b: The trigger ensures the waveform starts at the same point in every sweep, giving a stable, non-moving display for clear observation.

questions.question: The horizontal sweep of a CRO is generated by:

explanations.b: The electron beam moves left to right across the screen through the action of horizontal deflection plates, controlled by the time-base generator.

questions.question: Which parameter can be directly measured from a CRO screen?

explanations.b: By measuring the time period of one complete waveform cycle on the CRO and applying f=1/T, you can directly calculate the frequency.

questions.question: In a VR-based CRO lab, the signal generator is used to:

answers.b: Produce input signals for the CRO

explanations.b: The function generator creates different signal types—like sine, square, and triangular waves—that are sent to the CRO for visualization and analysis.

questions.question: The main advantage of a VR-based CRO experiment over a physical one is:

answers.c: It is safe, repeatable, and cost-effective
answers.d: It does not require understanding CRO controls

explanations.c: A VR-based CRO lab allows students to practice safely, repeat experiments, and reduce equipment costs.
